rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for something's worth or monetary value.

example.english: Does this old phone still have any value?
example.traditional: 呢部舊電話仲有冇價值？
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 zung6 jau5 mou5 gaa3 zik6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken verb for regarding something as important or valuable.

example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hou2 tai2 zung6 ni1 ci3 gei1 wui6

rows.note: Use this when you value something because you cherish it and do not want to lose it.

example.english: We will always value this friendship.
example.traditional: 呢段友情，我哋一定會珍惜。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 jau5 cing4 ngo5 dei6 jat1 ding6 wui5 zan1 sik1

rows.note: Use this for a person's or group's moral principles, beliefs, and ideals.

example.english: Their value system is very different from ours.
example.traditional: 佢哋嘅價值觀同我哋好唔同。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 ge3 gaa3 zik6 gun1 tung4 ngo5 dei6 hou2 m4 tung4

rows.note: Use this for the degree to which someone gives importance to something, rather than its worth or moral principles.

example.english: The way you arrange your time shows the value you place on your health.
example.traditional: 由你點樣安排時間，就睇得出你對健康嘅重視程度。
example.jyutping: jau4 nei5 dim2 joeng6 on1 paai4 si4 gaan1 zau6 tai2 dak1 ceot1 nei5 deoi3 gin6 hong1 ge3 zung6 si6 cing4 dou6

rows.note: Use this when determining or estimating the monetary value of an object, especially in an appraisal.

example.english: We need an expert to value this antique.
example.traditional: 呢隻古董要搵專家估價。
example.jyutping: ni1 zek3 gu2 dung2 jiu3 wan2 zyun1 gaa1 gu2 gaa3
